name: www.rescuetime.com
description:
RescueTime delivers two tools with one powerful app: RescueTime Focus, to improve concentration and automatically track time spent on apps and websites, and RescueTime Timesheets, to automate tracking time by client, project, or task.

Our agent integration allows you to report on and analyze your work day, enriched with expert material on productivity patterns and life balance. Project time data can be reorganized, researched and reported on alongside other resources using the powerful flexibility of your Claude connected agents.

_published_faq.name: How do I add www.rescuetime.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add www.rescuetime.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.rescuetime.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the www.rescuetime.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: www.rescuetime.com provides these MCP tools: get_focus_state, project_time_history, recent_activity, reference_documentation, start_focus_session, start_timer, stop_focus, and taxonomy_rollup.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to www.rescuetime.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to www.rescuetime.com in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
www.rescuetime.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
www.rescuetime.com is developed by RescueTime, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
